content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to know if it’s possible to connect an analog input to the ON delay so that the timing can be adjusted dynamically. My goal is to have a variable time depending on the analog input or output, rather than a fixed time. It seems this function is not available in [product_name] software, but I think it might be possible with the controller itself. I appreciate any information regarding this. Thank you in advance.
Hello [user_name], Please review the following resource: [url]. There, you’ll find an example titled "Using the reference function" which may help with your query.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to implement a dynamic ON delay timer that adjusts based on an analog signal in a [company_name] controller.
